artifacts.summary: Spec overturns the ideation's own premise with live evidence: Subscriptions itself never writes an expense row (only POST /api/subscriptions, writing a sub- record to the Subscriptions tab); the 3 reference rows are ordinary manual entries via the generic add-expense endpoint, and the only subscription-driven expense id/date format is the live scheduler's exp-auto-{subscriptionId}-{isoDate}. A live scan of production found a 4th manual row already covering Uber x February 2026, so the plan writes 20 new rows (not 21) and explicitly skips that one occurrence. New id scheme exp-sub065-{subscriptionId}-{isoDate} confirmed disjoint from all three existing families (exp-hist-, exp-auto-, plain exp-{timestamp}) across production's 4,749 rows. Also caught: the Subscriptions tab's paid_by (ijac) disagrees with the reference rows' paid_by (wei) - resolved to follow the reference rows. 11 ACs (AC-1-9 offline, AC-10/11 interactive), +180 LOC/3-file estimate at +-50% tolerance.
